brief: A solid deep indigo rectangle fills the entire screen without changing. A continuous white EKG waveform traces across this static background from left to right. The thin white trace itself pulses by rapidly alternating between pure white and a soft gray, creating a rhythmic breathing effect while the indigo backdrop remains completely still. No mouse interaction or sound input is required; the animation loops continuously.
